name: Lethal Arteriopathy Syndrome Due to Fibulin-4 Deficiency

criteria.description: Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the EFEMP2 (fibulin-4) gene
Presence of widespread arterial aneurysms and tortuosity on vascular imaging
Histological evidence of medial degeneration and elastic fiber fragmentation in arterial walls
Characteristic clinical features including severe arterial fragility and early-onset vascular complications

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Biallelic EFEMP2 pathogenic variants plus presence of arterial aneurysms and tortuosity on imaging
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic confirmation is essential; histopathology and clinical features support diagnosis.

pathognomonic.notes: Widespread involvement of large and medium arteries

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe arterial fragility leading to early rupture
pathognomonic.notes: Often fatal in infancy or early childhood

pathognomonic.symptomName: Elastic fiber fragmentation in arterial media
searchTerms: broken elastic fibers in artery walls
limited movement in big joints at birth

common.symptomName: Facial dysmorphism with hypertelorism and downslanting palpebral fissures
searchTerms: unusual facial features with large eye spacing
face with downward slanting eyelids and wide eyes

common.symptomName: Respiratory distress due to vascular complications
common.notes: Secondary to vascular rupture or compression
searchTerms: breathing problems from blood vessel issues
respiratory distress due to vascular problems
difficulty breathing caused by blood vessel complications
aortic valve does not close properly

occasional.symptomName: Neurological deficits secondary to cerebral aneurysms
searchTerms: neurological symptoms due to brain aneurysms
nerve deficits caused by cerebral artery issues

occasional.symptomName: Gastrointestinal bleeding from mesenteric artery involvement
searchTerms: intestinal bleeding due to artery involvement
bleeding in digestive tract from mesenteric arteries

rare.symptomName: Hearing loss due to vascular insufficiency
searchTerms: hearing loss from poor blood flow
hearing problems due to blood vessel issues

rare.symptomName: Psychiatric manifestations secondary to cerebrovascular events
searchTerms: mental health issues after brain vessel events

laboratory: Possible elevated inflammatory markers if vascular rupture occurs
imaging: CT angiography showing widespread arterial aneurysms and tortuosity
MRI angiography for cerebral vessel assessment
Echocardiography revealing aortic root dilation and valve insufficiency
other: Histopathology of arterial tissue showing elastic fiber fragmentation and medial degeneration

distinguishingFeatures: Craniofacial features such as bifid uvula
Thin translucent skin with visible veins
Spontaneous arterial rupture without widespread aneurysms

redFlags: Recurrent arterial rupture or dissection in infancy
Severe joint contractures with vascular fragility
references: Loeys BL, et al. Aneurysm syndromes caused by mutations in the TGF-beta receptor. N Engl J Med. 2006.
Zhang H, et al. Fibulin-4 deficiency results in arterial tortuosity and aneurysm formation. Hum Mol Genet. 2006.
